verdict.rationale: Terraform documents the review-gate parts of this workflow. `apply` prompts for approval of the plan (docs-25), plans can be saved to a file and only that file applied (docs-30), and plans can be exported as JSON for inspection (docs-48). HCP Terraform policy enforcement validates runs against Sentinel/OPA rules, with overrides handled in the workspace UI (docs-9, docs-54, docs-35), and the official MCP server gives agents workspace and run management (docs-56, docs-65). Missing for 10: any documented way to scope least-privilege credentials for an agent, an explicit agent-specific approval gate that blocks unapproved applies (note `-auto-approve` bypasses the prompt), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
